## Which part of the repo?

- [ ] **Specification** (`SPEC.md`, `schemas/`, `examples/`) — normative
- [ ] **Site or tooling** (`app/`, `lib/`, `scripts/`) — reference implementation
- [ ] Docs only

## For specification changes

Normative changes need a discussion first. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

- Linked issue:
- [ ] The reference examples under `examples/` still validate
- [ ] RFC 2119 keywords used deliberately (MUST / SHOULD / MAY)

## For implementation changes

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Behaviour still matches SPEC.md — where they disagree, the spec is correct
